description: Exact contractHash and registrationHash values (contract-document.md section 6). Each case gives a document and the two hashes a conformant implementation computes from it: build the projection P (section 6.2 steps 1-5), canonicalize with RFC 8785, SHA-256, lowercase hex, prefix 'sha256:'. Several cases are deliberately decorated, reordered, renamed, hoisted or annotated, and their expected values equal an undecorated case's - proving an implementation performs each normalization step rather than hashing its input verbatim. A case without 'projection' hashes its document as it stands (required of every contract-document producer and client generator). A case with 'projection' first projects the document - kind 'topic' is the topic-scoped projection of section 5.3, kind 'include-list' the include-list projection of section 5.2 - and expects the hashes of that projection (client generators only).

cases.name: minimal-document
cases.description: One request entry, inline schemas, no events or sends.

cases.name: identity-and-decoration-are-outside-the-hash
cases.description: minimal-document plus every field outside P (identity, runtime, placement, profile, degraded, endpoint, transports, an example, stale hash values): same two hashes as minimal-document.

cases.name: benzene-entries-are-ignored
cases.description: minimal-document plus a benzene: entry a producer must not emit: a consumer ignores it, so the hashes equal minimal-document's.

cases.name: hoisted-components
cases.description: Every named type hoisted into components and referenced by $ref.

cases.name: inline-schemas
cases.description: The same wire shapes as hoisted-components, all inline, with properties and required in a different order: the same two hashes.

cases.name: renamed-components
cases.description: hoisted-components with two components renamed: names are not contract, so the same two hashes.

cases.name: entries-in-registration-order
cases.description: Three entries, a versioned one first, and httpMappings in arbitrary order.

cases.name: entries-sorted-and-methods-lower-case
cases.description: entries-in-registration-order's entries in another order, with httpMappings methods in lower case: the same two hashes.

cases.name: annotations-are-outside-the-hash
cases.description: minimal-document with title, description, format, example, default, readOnly, $schema and x- keywords added: the same two hashes.

cases.name: validation-constraints-are-contract
cases.description: minimal-document with a minLength added: a validation rule is a contract change, so both hashes differ from minimal-document's.

cases.name: object-without-members
cases.description: minimal-document with response {"type":"object"}.

cases.name: empty-required-and-properties-are-removed
cases.description: object-without-members with an empty properties object and an empty required array, which the projection removes: the same two hashes.

cases.name: nullable-reference-hoisted
cases.description: A nullable property of a named object type, hoisted: the wrapper {type, nullable, allOf:[$ref]}.

cases.name: nullable-reference-inlined
cases.description: nullable-reference-hoisted with the named type inlined inside the same wrapper: the same two hashes.

cases.name: reference-siblings-are-ignored
cases.description: nullable-reference-hoisted with a description on the wrapper and a sibling keyword beside $ref (an OpenAPI 3.0 Reference Object ignores its siblings): the same two hashes.

cases.name: discriminator-mapping
cases.description: A oneOf with a discriminator whose mapping names components.

cases.name: discriminator-mapping-renamed
cases.description: discriminator-mapping with the variants renamed: discriminator.mapping holds component names and is outside the hash, so the same two hashes.

cases.name: absent-response
cases.description: A handler with no response payload: response is absent.

cases.name: unconstrained-response
cases.description: The same topic with response {} (a payload of any shape): different hashes from absent-response.

cases.name: recursive-component
cases.description: A self-referencing component: the projection cuts the cycle with {}.

cases.name: recursive-component-renamed
cases.description: recursive-component with the type named Node: the same two hashes.

cases.name: nullable-wrapper-around-cycle
cases.description: A self-referencing component whose nullable parent property wraps the cut reference: the wrapper becomes {} as a whole.

cases.name: nullable-wrapper-around-cycle-annotated
cases.description: nullable-wrapper-around-cycle with the wrapper carrying a description and no type: still a wrapper once annotations are removed, so the same two hashes.

cases.name: canonical-service
cases.description: The canonical service (conformance/README.md): one request, one event, two sends.

cases.name: canonical-service-without-sends
cases.description: canonical-service with no sends: contractHash is unchanged; registrationHash differs.

cases.name: two-topic-service
cases.description: canonical-service plus a second request topic, conformance:farewell, with no response.

cases.name: topic-scoped-projection
cases.description: two-topic-service projected to the topic conformance:farewell (contract-document §5.3): one request, no events or sends, components narrowed; hashes recomputed over the projection.

cases.name: include-list-projection
cases.description: two-topic-service projected by the include-list [conformance:farewell] (contract-document §5.2): events, sends and components pass through unnarrowed; hashes recomputed over the projection, so they differ from both two-topic-service's and topic-scoped-projection's.
